newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine death toll from disasters down in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Philippine death toll from disasters down in 1996.

text.p: Natural and man-made disasters killed 523 people in the Philippines in the first 11 months of last year, sharply down from the death toll for the same period in 1995, a government year-end report said on Monday.

The deaths occurred in incidents such as floods, typhoons, landslides, earthquakes, tornados, whirlwinds, fires, boat sinkings, riots, building collapses and bomb explosions, the National Disaster Coordinating Council said.
A total of 1,180 people died from similar incidents in the country during the same period in 1995, it said.
